A tree as a screen. The mouse and the keyboard reach it, so callbacks fire, boxes drag, scrollbar thumbs can be grabbed, and the `hover:`, `focus:` and `active:` variants have something to answer.

Layout runs again only when something has moved: a style, a property, the tree, a drag or a scroll bumps the dom's revision, and a resize changes the screen. Every other frame draws the boxes that were already worked out.

The same tree drawn over the game instead is a `CTMLHud`, which hears nothing from the user and so fires no callbacks.

```java
import net.tutla.craftytml.client.render.CTMLScreen;
```
